description: This file contains a report implementation for warehouse-wise item balance, age, and value in ERPNext, including functions for data retrieval, validation, and report column setup.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate warehouse-wise item balance, age, and value report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates and sets default filters for the report.

methods.name: get_warehouse_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of permitted warehouses based on user permissions and filters.

methods.name: add_warehouse_column
methods.description: Adds warehouse-specific columns to the report columns list.
